purpose: Bounded tenfold smaller-update grasp pilot after low-noise formal0/100 and untrained-reference development10/14
promotion: 100-episode grasp success>=80%, drops<=10%, and policy success/drop counts at least as good as matched hold baseline; no auto-rotation
training_reset: All seven placement buckets plus frozen continuous position/yaw jitter; no retries or outcome filtering

controlled_comparison.unchanged: Fresh seed0 default actor/critic initialization, initial_log_std=-4, architecture, optimizer class, reward, physical/reset/observation/action contracts,200k budget,development selection
controlled_comparison.formal_comparison: New formal cases; not a paired old/new policy comparison
controlled_comparison.launch_precondition: Previous low-exploration job and all three formal evaluations complete with failed gate preserved; initialization and resume checks pass
controlled_comparison.rationale: Shared-factory reconstructed default untrained actor10/14 versus hold7/14 on fixed development cases; trained100k actor0/14 with large commanded posture drift. This motivates testing smaller updates, not a claim that default initialization is the root cause or that a smaller learning rate will converge.
